## Change

Describe the user-visible result.

## Verification

List each verification command and its result.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has one clear purpose.
- [ ] Tests cover each new observable contract.
- [ ] Documents and comments use ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.
- [ ] The change contains no token, private hostname, private address, personal path, or personal data.
- The changelog includes an entry for each user-visible change.
- A change with no user-visible effect needs no changelog entry.
